study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Meijer et al., Journal of Abnormal Psychology, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Toward Understanding Autism Heterogeneity: Identifying Clinical Subgroups and Neuroanatomical Deviations

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Warped likelihood Bayesian Linear Regression (SinArcinh likelihood warping) implemented in the PCNtoolkit.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Here, we performed normative modeling on CT and subcortical regions of interests (ROIs) using warped likelihood Bayesian Linear Regression (Fraza et al., 2021) model implemented in the PCNtoolkit (Version 0.26) in Python (Version 3.9.16).

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (CT) using Destrieux parcellation (148 ROIs) and subcortical volume using ASEG atlas (23 ROIs).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Next, we ran normative modeling on CT and subcortical parcellations (N autism = 690, N NAI = 744) ... A separate normative model was built for each of the 148 CT ROIs and 23 subcortical ROIs independently.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, site, FIQ (full-scale intelligence quotient), Euler number, and intracranial volume (for subcortical volumes). Sex was included in the combined model analysis.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We included age, site, FIQ, and quality measures (i.e., the Euler number) as covariates and additional intracranial volume for subcortical volumes.
